kitchens.name: Annapurna Kitchen
kitchens.bio: Light Gujarati and North Indian food, less oil, fresh phulkas.
kitchens.story: I have cooked for my family of six for 25 years. My kadhi and thepla are what neighbours ask for most. Everything is made the same morning in small batches.
kitchens.statusNote: Kitchen visit done. Welcome to RasoiSe!

kitchens.name: Nanak's Rasoi
kitchens.bio: Maa di dal, soft tawa rotis and seasonal sarson da saag.
kitchens.story: Punjabi home food the way my mother-in-law taught me in Ludhiana. No cream from a packet, no colour. Just slow-cooked dal and fresh rotis.
kitchens.statusNote: Kitchen visit done. Welcome to RasoiSe!

kitchens.name: Konkan Ghar
kitchens.bio: Malvani fish curries, sol kadhi and bhakri from a Konkan family kitchen.
kitchens.story: My family is from Malvan. Fish comes from Versova jetty every morning. There is always a veg option the same day.
kitchens.statusNote: Kitchen visit done. Welcome to RasoiSe!

kitchens.name: Amma's Kitchen
kitchens.bio: Tamil home meals: sambar, rasam, poriyal and curd rice.
kitchens.story: Simple Iyer-style meals, cooked in a little coconut oil. Dosa batter is ground at home twice a week.
kitchens.statusNote: Kitchen visit done. Welcome to RasoiSe!

kitchens.name: Sindhi Swaad
kitchens.bio: Sai bhaji, Sindhi kadhi and koki, the way my nani made it.
kitchens.story: Sindhi food is hard to find outside a Sindhi home. I cook it the old way, with plenty of greens.
kitchens.statusNote: Kitchen visit done. Welcome to RasoiSe!

kitchens.name: Bawarchi Bibi
kitchens.bio: Home-style dum biryani, korma and Friday nihari.
kitchens.story: Biryani on wood-fire dum like at family weddings, but in tiffin portions. Every day has a veg option too.
kitchens.statusNote: Kitchen visit done. Welcome to RasoiSe!

kitchens.name: Healthy Thali by Ritu
kitchens.bio: Low-oil, high-protein thalis. Jain option every day.
kitchens.story: I am a nutritionist. These are the meals I plan for my clients: millet rotis, sprouts, lots of vegetables, no maida.
kitchens.statusNote: Kitchen visit done. Welcome to RasoiSe!

kitchens.name: Meera's Pulao House
kitchens.bio: Maharashtrian pulao, varan bhaat and amti.

reviews.comment: Proper maa di dal and the rotis were still soft at 1 pm. Ordered a trial, will be back for a plan.

reply.body: Thank you Neha ji! Do come back.

reviews.comment: The kadhi is exactly like my Gujarati neighbour aunty makes. Light and not too sweet.
Very good food. Rice was a little less one day, otherwise perfect.
Office lunch sorted. Rajma chawal on Wednesday is the highlight of my week.
Tasty and filling. Wish there was a salad on more days.
Rasam tastes like home in Chennai. Amma remembered I can't eat peanuts. Thank you!

reply.body: Thank you kanna. Always no peanuts for you.

reviews.comment: Had Sindhi kadhi for the first time. Loved the koki too!
Surmai curry was fantastic, fresh fish and real kokum in the sol kadhi.
Food was good but delivery was 30 minutes late.
Finally a Jain tiffin that isn't boring. Millet rotis are great.
Biryani was really good, generous chicken pieces.
Rotis were cold and the korma was very oily today. Container lid was also loose.

messages.body: Dinner came at 8:55 pm, almost 30 minutes after the slot. Fish was lukewarm.
Very sorry Aditya ji, my delivery boy had a puncture. It will not happen again.
Resolved by RasoiSe support with a ₹60 refund to the wallet. Thanks for your patience.

tickets.resolution: Partial refund for the late delivery.

messages.body: The korma container lid was loose and gravy had leaked into the bag. Rotis were cold too.
I am sorry. We changed to new containers this week. I will check every lid myself.
